resample_strand: resample a hair strand to a fixed number of points using linear interpolation between segments
smooth_strands: smooth a batch of hair strands using a Laplacian-based sparse linear solver with position constraints
spline_strand: interpolate a hair strand to a target point count using Catmull-Rom spline evaluation
augment_strand: augment a single hair strand with random Z-axis rotation and XYZ stretch transformations
duplicate_strands: duplicate each hair strand N times with random perpendicular offsets to increase strand density
